title: Linear Regression

plan.insight: The best line minimises the sum of squared residuals; moving points or the line changes that sum.
plan.user_changes: drag data points, click to add points, slope/intercept of your own line, snap to best fit
plan.reacts: residual segments, your MSE vs best MSE, loss landscape position

init: return { pts: range(10).map(() => { const x = rand() * 8 + 1; return [x, 0.8 * x + 1 + randn(0, 1)]; }) };

components.label: Best fit
components.onClick:
const f = linreg(state.pts.map((p) => p[0]), state.pts.map((p) => p[1]));
return { m: round(clamp(f.m, -2, 3), 2), b: round(clamp(f.b, -4, 8), 2) };

components.title: Drag points, click to add
components.onDrag: return { pts: state.pts.map((p, i) => i === index ? [pos.x, pos.y] : p) };

components.title: MSE vs slope
components.draw:
const loss = (m) => mse(state.pts.map((p) => m * p[0] + state.b), state.pts.map((p) => p[1]));
return [line(linspace(-2, 3, 80).map((m) => [m, loss(m)]), { color: 'gray' }), point(state.m, loss(state.m), { color: 'orange' })];

components.label: Your MSE
components.value: return mse(state.pts.map((p) => state.m * p[0] + state.b), state.pts.map((p) => p[1]));

components.label: Best MSE
components.value:
const f = linreg(state.pts.map((p) => p[0]), state.pts.map((p) => p[1]));
return mse(state.pts.map((p) => f.m * p[0] + f.b), state.pts.map((p) => p[1]));
